p.modal-link: What does an accepted or rejected status mean?

div.p: If you don’t get an email within 2 days, go to your dashboard to chat with Direct File customer support and check the status of your tax return.
If the IRS finds additional errors in your resubmitted tax return, you’ll receive another rejection notification. You’ll need to fix the additional errors and resubmit again.

modal-dialog.modal-heading: What does an accepted or rejected status mean?

modal-content.p: When your tax return has been processed, you’ll receive an email from IRS Direct File explaining what to do if your tax return is accepted or rejected.

ul.li: Accepted status: If your federal tax return is accepted, we’ll explain how to pay your tax balance or check the status of your tax refund.
Rejected status: If your federal tax return is rejected, we’ll explain how to correct your tax return and resubmit.
